name: selection-frame
title: Selection frame
description: KAMUI-14, the one selection for every kind of object: a 1.25 green ring with a flat collar at offset 6, eight handles on the ring line, and a graphite readout of the measured frame. Hover shows only faint corner dots and an edge light.
